comment: The one source of the framework versions the shipped adapters are built against. python/pyproject.toml's torch and max extras must equal the two requirement strings (packaging/adapters/test_adapters.py). A Torch C++ extension is bound to one Torch minor series, one backend and one C++ ABI, so each vendor builds against the wheel its users install: PyPI's default torch for NVIDIA and macOS, PyTorch's ROCm index for AMD. wheel_sha256 null means the leg records the digest the index serves; set it to pin the exact file.
